task: Rename the visible secondary Bol source to Muisstil

producers.source_condition: The authenticated scanner has its fixed secondary source configured.
producers.user_impact: The operator can identify the secondary worklist before scanning.
producers.recovery: Select Bankhoes or Muisstil before scanning; source switching stays disabled during a live decision.
producers.copy_purpose: Name the fixed secondary account without exposing its internal identity.
producers.external_proof: Browser assertion and production desktop/mobile inspection.

producers.source_condition: An operator selects the Muisstil account tab.
producers.user_impact: Assistive-technology users can identify the selected account before scanning.
producers.recovery: Use the account tab control to select the intended source.
producers.copy_purpose: Expose the same selected account choice to assistive technology.

what_must_not_appear: Client Bol as the current secondary operator label
Bol credentials, tokens, account identifiers, or raw upstream payloads
